_note: Starter library for review by the HS team (e.g. Laura). The evidence field names the general practice only; each entry needs a verified evidence source before the library is presented as 'evidence-based' to USBE.

strategies.name: Targeted tutoring / small-group live session
strategies.description: Teacher or tutor runs a recurring small-group or 1:1 live session on the specific failing course content.

strategies.name: Academic recovery plan
strategies.description: Student, teacher and family agree on a written plan: assignments to recover, dates, and a weekly check.
strategies.evidence: Goal-setting and progress monitoring - source to verify

strategies.name: Counselor schedule and pathway review
strategies.description: Counselor reviews course load and graduation pathway; adjusts schedule or refers to credit recovery.

strategies.name: Weekly missing-work report to family
strategies.description: Mentor sends the Learning Coach a weekly list of missing work with due dates and a contact for help.
strategies.evidence: Family communication about missing assignments - source to verify

strategies.name: Structured work-completion block
strategies.description: Student attends a scheduled live study hall with a staff member until missing work drops below threshold.

strategies.name: Pacing plan reset
strategies.description: Counselor and teachers build a revised pacing calendar the student can realistically finish.

strategies.name: Mentor daily check-in / check-out
strategies.description: Mentor checks in at the start and end of each school day for 2-4 weeks and tracks logins.

strategies.name: Re-engagement conference
strategies.description: Live meeting with student, Learning Coach, mentor and counselor to identify barriers and set a return plan.

strategies.name: Attendance improvement plan
strategies.description: Written plan with the family covering barriers, daily attendance expectations, and a weekly review.
strategies.evidence: Attendance plans / tiered attendance supports - source to verify

strategies.name: Mentor attendance check-in
strategies.description: Mentor contacts student and Learning Coach after each unexcused day; logs contact and reason.

strategies.name: Attendance team meeting
strategies.description: Attendance team, counselor and family meet; plan includes supports and, where required, statutory steps.
strategies.evidence: Local practice - source to verify; statutory steps need compliance review
